decision.what: Task-to-ask join is strict wording overlap (3 or more shared words and 50 percent of the ask's words); no existing task carries an ask source, so only 1 matched.
decision.alternative: A 34-40 percent share found 9 to 19 matches but mostly false ones; rejected so 'done' is never guessed.

decision.what: Unroutable = not done and no module folder: 449 refined asks (module site or unknown) plus 16 ledger asks whose title names no module. Refined and routed asks are two kinds that sum to the total; a dropped ledger ask counts as done.
decision.alternative: Fold unroutable into undone; rejected because no inbox or module can own them.

decision.what: Added a second Servex line: LogSweeper.ALLOW commits ai/asks/undone.json so the daily rebuild is not a loose dirty file.
decision.alternative: Leave it dirty; rejected as a loose end.
